# BBA Agency

> BBA Agency is an informational website for an AI-first platform concept that organizes institutional knowledge, Missions, AI Workforce execution, Human Governance, Institutional Assets, Channel Variants, Distribution Packages, and Audit Records.

The website explains BBA Agency Products, illustrative Project examples, and Delivery Packages. It is a static reference website: it does not create Projects, perform approvals, retain customer data, execute external Connectors, or publish to third-party channels.

## Primary pages

- [BBA Agency home](https://bba.country/): Overview of the BBA Agency concept and the customer outcomes it describes.
- [Products](https://bba.country/services): Catalog of BBA Agency Products and their scope.
- [Project examples](https://bba.country/projects): Informational examples of how a customer outcome can be organized.
- [Delivery Packages](https://bba.country/deliveries): Informational examples of reviewed deliverables and their traceability.

## Products

- [BBA Publisher](https://bba.country/services/publisher): The first functional product experience, explained on this informational site.
- [Advertising Campaign](https://bba.country/services/advertising): Planned Product for coordinated strategy and creative direction.
- [Scientific Article](https://bba.country/services/scientific-writing): Planned Product for structured, reviewable manuscript preparation.
- [Governance Proposal](https://bba.country/services/governance): Planned Product for evidence-based institutional proposals.
- [Market Research](https://bba.country/services/research): Planned Product for evidence-based market analysis and recommendations.

## Representative examples

- [Neurons Protocol Launch](https://bba.country/projects/neurons-protocol-launch): Informational Project example associated with BBA Publisher.
- [AI Publishing Research Article](https://bba.country/projects/ai-publishing-research-article): Informational Project example for the Scientific Article Product.
- [Enterprise AI Publishing Market Study](https://bba.country/projects/enterprise-ai-publishing-market-study): Informational Project example for the Market Research Product.
- [Scientific Package](https://bba.country/deliveries/scientific-package): Illustrative Delivery Package for a Scientific Article outcome.
- [Research Package](https://bba.country/deliveries/research-package): Illustrative Delivery Package for a Market Research outcome.

## Related resource

- [BBA Publisher prototype](https://dev.bba.country): Separately hosted functional prototype. It demonstrates a limited BBA Publisher experience and does not prove a completed BBA Platform, external publication, live autonomous agents, or active external Connectors.

## Scope and limitations

Human Governance remains responsible for important decisions. Channel constraints described on the site are illustrative, not guaranteed current third-party platform rules. External publication is not performed through this website or the BBA Publisher prototype.
